title: Physical Units Registry
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Central registry of allowed physical units for use in `{"value": N, "unit": "..."}` objects throughout the project. Per ADR-0008, all numeric physical quantities in JSON MUST use this format. Allowed units are defined here and referenced by individual schemas via `"$ref`.

value.description: Numeric magnitude. Must be finite (no NaN, no Infinity).

unit.description: Physical unit identifier. Must be one of the allowed units listed in `$defs/allowed_units`.

allowed_units.description: Documentation of allowed units and their meanings.

m/s.description: Meters per second — unit of velocity.

m/s².description: Meters per second squared — unit of acceleration.

rad/s.description: Radians per second — unit of angular velocity.

dimensionless.description: Dimensionless quantity (pure ratio, no physical unit).
